chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, by a chain of his, said:

key_terms.بَرَهُوتُ: Barhout, a specific well/valley in Hell

ai.seo_question: What is the worst well in Hellfire according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies Barhout as the deepest and most severe well in Hell, specifically designated for the souls of the disbelievers. This description aligns with Shia exegetical traditions that interpret 'Barhout' not merely as a physical location but as a profound spiritual abyss reflecting the depth of disbelief, emphasizing the finality of their punishment.
